sentences.text: Lynyrd Skynyrd -LRB- pronounced -LSB- ˌlɛnərd_ˈskɪnərd -RSB- -RRB- is an American rock band best known for popularizing the Southern rock genre during the 1970s .	Southern rock	Southern rock	rock	rock music

Originally formed in 1964 as My Backyard in Jacksonville , Florida , the band was also known by names such as The Noble Five and One Percent , before finally deciding on `` Lynyrd Skynyrd '' in 1969 .
The band gained worldwide recognition for its live performances and signature songs `` Sweet Home Alabama '' and `` Free Bird '' .	Sweet Home Alabama	Sweet Home Alabama	Free Bird	Free Bird

At the peak of their success , two band members and a backup singer died in an airplane crash in 1977 , putting an abrupt end to the band 's most popular incarnation .	airplane crash in 1977	1977 Convair CV-240 crash
The band has sold 28 million records in the United States .

The surviving band members reformed in 1987 for a reunion tour with lead vocalist Johnny Van Zant , the younger brother of lead singer and founder Ronnie Van Zant .	Van Zant	Van Zant	Johnny Van Zant	Johnny Van Zant	Ronnie Van Zant	Ronnie Van Zant

Lynyrd Skynyrd continues to tour and record with co-founder Gary Rossington , Johnny Van Zant , and guitarist Rickey Medlocke -- who first wrote and recorded with the band from 1971 to 1972 -LRB- before his return to Lynyrd Skynyrd in 1996 -RRB- .	Van Zant	Van Zant	Gary Rossington	Gary Rossington	Rickey Medlocke	Rickey Medlocke	Johnny Van Zant	Johnny Van Zant

Fellow founding member Larry Junstrom , along with '70s members Ed King and Artimus Pyle , remain active in music but no longer tour or record with the band .	Larry Junstrom	Larry Junstrom	Ed King	Ed King	Artimus Pyle	Artimus Pyle
Longtime drummer Michael Cartellone has recorded and toured with the band since 1999 .	Michael Cartellone	Michael Cartellone
Lynyrd Skynyrd was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame on March 13 , 2006 .	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
